verdict.rationale: Handling SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat alongside email is a fair question for an inbox product like Outlook, so the axis applies. Every evidence item covers email-only capabilities: messages, inbox rules, delegation, sending mail and change notifications. Nothing shows non-email customer channels arriving in the same inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
